# Delivery Quality Knowledge

## Purpose

Explain the reusable practices that turn implementation evidence into a safe merge and release decision.

## Scope

This library covers CI quality gates and release readiness. It complements testing, review, architecture, and production-operability guidance.

## When to use

Use it when defining repository checks, reviewing required evidence, planning a release, or deciding whether a change is ready for production.

## When not to use

Do not use generic gates or a checklist score as a substitute for risk assessment, production ownership, or an explicit release decision.
